{
  let top: number;
  const read = () => top;
  read();
}
function outer() {
  let deep: string;
  return () => () => deep.length;
}
function fields() {
  let seed: number;
  class Holder {
    value = seed;
    get doubled() { return seed * 2; }
  }
  return Holder;
}
function auto() {
  let x;
  x ??= 1;
  const f = () => x;
  return f;
}
function known() {
  let y: number;
  const f = () => {
    if (typeof y === "number") return y;
    if (y !== undefined) return y;
    return 0;
  };
  return f;
}
function counter() {
  let n: number;
  const bump = () => n++;
  return bump;
}
function pair() {
  let a: number, b = 1;
  return () => a + b;
}
outer(); fields(); auto(); known(); counter(); pair();
function run() { let message: string; function show() { console.log(message); } show(); }
function a() { let x: number; const f = () => x; return f; }
function d() { let x: number; [1].forEach(() => console.log(x)); }
let g: number; function h() { return g; }
run(); a(); d(); h();
